vision: A distributable library of AI agent rules, skills, and hooks with a file-based adversarial harness — health audit cycle remediating two dead hooks, five undocumented rules, and a harness-gate blind spot for short prompts.

tasks.name: Register evaluator-guard + chain-evaluator in hooks.json
tasks.scope: .cursor/hooks.json only. Add evaluator-guard.sh as preToolUse(Write) and chain-evaluator.sh as subagentStop. Done when both hooks appear in hooks.json with correct event keys.

tasks.name: Fix AGENTS.md: hooks table + glob-scoped rules + ACAM date
tasks.scope: AGENTS.md only. Add 4 missing registered hooks (harness-gate, dedup-server, pre-commit-harness, enforce-progress); mark chain-evaluator/evaluator-guard as unregistered; add 5 glob-scoped rules (architecture, causal_rigor, python_ml, research_standards, testing); update ACAM Status date to 2026-07-14. Done when every hook.json entry has a row and 5 glob rules are documented.

tasks.name: Deduplicate overlapping skill trigger phrases
tasks.scope: library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md, experiment-report/SKILL.md, structured-presentation/SKILL.md (+ .cursor/ sync). Remove 'write findings' and 'analyze results' from experiment-workflow (they belong to experiment-report); remove 'create report' / 'write report' collision between structured-presentation and experiment-report. Done when no trigger phrase is shared across two or more overlapping skills.

tasks.name: Fix harness-gate glue threshold to catch short feature prompts
tasks.scope: library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh + .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh. Raise glue threshold from 25 to 50 chars OR add word-count heuristic (>=4 words = non-glue). Done when 'refatora tudo', 'migra o banco', 'adiciona autenticação' each trigger routing advice in a unit test run.

tasks.name: Fire skill-suggest on every prompt, not just sessionStart
tasks.scope: library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh + .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh. Add skill-suggest.py invocation to beforeSubmitPrompt so suggestions appear for all messages, not just the first. Done when running harness-gate.sh with a skill-triggering prompt returns SKILL SUGGESTIONS block in followup_message.
